The '''Twin Starmie''' team (Japanese: '''ツインスターミー''' ''Twin Starmie'') are minor recurring characters in {{aniseries|SM}}. They are students at the [[Pokémon School]].

==History==
They first appeared in ''[[SM019|A Guardian Rematch!]]'', where they watched {{Ash}} {{pkmn|battle}} against {{DL|Guardian deities (anime)|Tapu Koko}}.

They appeared again in ''[[SM041|Mounting an Electrifying Charge!]]'', where they entered the [[Charjabug race]] with a {{p|Charjabug}}. They raced against {{Ash}}, {{an|Sophocles}}, and {{an|Kiawe}}, who had entered with [[Sophocles's Charjabug]]; and {{TRT}}, who disguised {{MTR}} as a Charjabug. During the race, the Twin Starmie team managed to get to the first section, where they were stopped by a {{p|Boldore}} creating a huge wall of rocks. The team tried to copy the Sophocles Lab team's strategy of overcoming this by having their Charjabug launch of the team's runner's back, but due to their racing car not being sturdy enough, it broke. With this, the Twin Starmie team was eliminated from the race.

They appeared again during a fantasy in the [[Poké Problem]] segment for [[SM083]].
